turns.text: Can you go through group X and tell me which products have a margin out of line with the rest, and which ones are big enough to dig into?

csvChecks.ask: results.csv with columns year,group,product,revenue,cogs,margin,group_margin,deviation_bps,outlier,detail_needed: one row per product and year whose margin you could work out, margin and group_margin as fractions (0.25, not 25%), deviation_bps as the product's margin minus the group's in basis points, outlier and detail_needed as true or false
